messages:
maria (Partnerships): Quick thread to prep SI Connect's marketplace listing + security integration. Focus: SAML/SCIM, BYO-KMS/HSM handshake, secrets connector smoke, and embargo timing.

dmitri (SI): We can provide SAML IdP metadata, a SCIM v2 staging endpoint, and a BYO-KMS gateway (PKCS#11) with attestation. Will upload artifacts to the partner bucket.

owen (Eng): Can you include OIDC fallback details and the exact SAML attributes (email, groups, roles)? Also please share expected NameID formats.

dmitri (SI): OIDC client creds will be ready by EOD. SAML NameID: email and transient; attributes: email, displayName, groups, role. Metadata link: https://partners.siconnect/staging/idp-meta.xml (48h).

zoe (Security): Requirements: IP allowlist template for SCIM callbacks, mutual-TLS option for SCIM webhook, HSM attestation bundle (cert chain + firmware hash), and KMS key policy draft. Also need p50/p95/p99 wrap/unwrap latencies.

dmitri (SI): KMS staging stats: p50=5ms, p95=18ms, p99=48ms, max concurrent ops=160. Attestation: FIPS 140-2 L3 bundle incoming.

owen (Eng): Quick smoke run snippet (staging):
```
# create user via SCIM
curl -X POST https://scim.staging.siconnect/v2/Users -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SCIM>' -d '{"userName":"rbx-smoke","emails":[{"value":"eng+smoke@redwood.com"}]}'
# create secret
curl -X POST https://staging.siconnect/api/secrets -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API>' -d '{"name":"rbx/smoke","value":"s3cret"}'
# fetch via Redwood
REDWOOD_SECRET=siconnect://rbx/smoke node scripts/get-secret.js
```

zoe (Security): Two open items: SCIM bulk throttling semantics (atomic vs chunked) and the HSM concurrency behavior under bursts. Need these to configure connector retries and queue sizes.

dmitri (SI): SCIM bulk supports chunked uploads (max 250/user chunk) and returns X-RateLimit-* headers; can enable atomic batch on request. HSM concurrency handled via a token pool; we'll provide a short load report.

maria (Partnerships): Action items: Dmitri upload metadata, OIDC creds, attestation, and throttle/telemetry report (by EOD tomorrow). Owen prepare runbook + connector backoff (by Mon). Zoe publish security checklist & IP allowlist template (today). I'll draft embargo window and send calendar invite for the smoke run.

legal-bot: Reminder: please upload the partner MSA redline to /collab/partners/SIConnect and add approved co-brand phrases before the embargo ends. Missing docs will delay the announcement.

dmitri (SI): Understood. Legal will receive the redline and we'll hold announcement copy until sign-off.

maria (Partnerships): Scheduling a 30-min smoke test Tue 09:00 PT. Invite with runbook attached. No external PR before both legal teams approve. :lock:

owen (Eng): I'll be on the call with the staging harness ready.

zoe (Security): I'll join for checklist sign-off.

maria (Partnerships): Thanks everyone.
